name: Suzhou New District Hi-Tech Industrial Co.,Ltd
summary: Suzhou New District Hi-Tech Industrial Co.,Ltd engages in the park operation, industrial investment, and industrial and urban development businesses in China. The company is also involved in real estate development, operation, and project construction management; investment in the environmental protection industry; research and development of energy technologies; financial leasing business; and wholesale of medical devices.
